chunks: By this chain of narration, he said: The Messenger of God (may God's blessings be upon him and his family) said:
God, exalted is His majesty, said: O son of Adam! Remember Me for a moment after the morning prayer and for a moment after the afternoon prayer, and I will suffice you from what worries you.

key_terms.أكفك: I will suffice you - divine promise of protection and provision
key_terms.اذكرني: Remember Me - divine command for dhikr (remembrance)
key_terms.ما أهمك: What worries you - worldly concerns and anxieties

ai.seo_question: What does the hadith qudsi say about remembering God after prayer?
ai.summary: This hadith qudsi continues from the same chain as the previous narration (51:7). God promises that whoever remembers Him briefly after the morning (fajr/ghada) and afternoon (Asr) prayers will be granted divine sufficiency in their affairs. This was a common teaching in the prophetic assemblies, emphasizing that dhikr (remembrance of God) at these two key times brackets the day with spiritual protection.

en.bilal-muhammad: By this isnad, he said: The
Messenger of Allah (s) said: Allah said: O son of Adam! Remember Me for a moment after morning and for a moment after `Asr, and I will suffice you from what worries you.
